content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00048 An RTE Generator tools SHALL support the merging of AUTOSAR models that have been split up and stored in multiple partial models while reading an set of files. Thereby the to be supported minimum granularity of an AUTOSAR model is defined by ≪ atpSplitable ≫ . The Merging of a model also includes the resolution of refer- ences. The RTE Generator SHALL be able to read the submodels in any order. There is no preference.
